snippet.title: Ad Mortem - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Kickstarter live at: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/admortem/ad-mortem
Wishlist Ad Mortem on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1624930/Ad_Mortem
Join our Discord server to stay updated: https://discord.gg/admortem


Hello everyone, it's been a LONG while (almost half a decade) since i posted a vid. I've been here the whole time and i am still reading the YT comments. This is what we've been cooking up since:

Rise, Vessel, and step foot into the corrupted world of Contrara.

Ad Mortem is a brutal multiplayer medieval Melee Slasher. Engage in team-based PvP combat upon the ravaged battlefields of two warring factions: the Palisadean and the Hantrii. Defeat your enemies in Assault, our focused 5 versus 5 competitive mode with engaging objectives and carefully crafted level design. Play alone or with up to 4 other players in Co-Op, slaying monsters & men in the dark domains of the Deities in a mad quest of retribution and power. Alternatively - dive into the chaos of casually oriented 10v10 Assault, community servers, or challenge your friends at your leisure in the Duelyard.

Everything in the trailer is captured from pre-alpha gameplay. Aspects of the game are subject to change. 

Ad Mortem is continually being developed; check the Discord and socials to see what's coming next. We are looking to crowdfund this year, it's been a tough journey developing this alongside our day jobs. Thanks everyone, i hope to see you all on the battlefield. Let us know what you guys think!
